issues.description: Method name inconsistency: the template's example code calls the method farm.feed(), while the problem statement and the solution reference the method feedAllAnimals(). Specifically, TEMPLATE_REPOSITORY/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java contains a call to farm.feed() (line 20) in the example code; the PROBLEM_STATEMENT describes and requires Farm.feedAllAnimals() (problem_statement.md lines 108-111); and SOLUTION_REPOSITORY/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java invokes farm.feedAllAnimals() (line 20). This mismatch (farm.feed vs feedAllAnimals) can confuse students about which method to implement or expect on the Farm class, and may lead to implementing the wrong API or being unsure whether to provide a delegating convenience method.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template consistent with the specification. Either (A) change the example call in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java from farm.feed() to farm.feedAllAnimals(), or (B) add a small convenience method public void feed() in the template Farm class that delegates to feedAllAnimals() (e.g., public void feed() { feedAllAnimals(); }). Ensure the example code and the Farm API (problem statement and solution) use the same method name so students are not confused about which method to implement.

issues.description: Concept: feeding all animals on the farm. Problem statement and solution use the method name feedAllAnimals(), but the template's example usage in Main.java calls farm.feed(). Specifically: problem_statement.md describes and requires a Farm method feedAllAnimals(); template/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java (line 20) calls farm.feed(); solution/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java (line 20) calls farm.feedAllAnimals(), and solution/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java implements public void feedAllAnimals(). This inconsistent identifier for the same concept (feeding all animals) can confuse students: they may look for feed() in the required API described by the exercise or assume the template is authoritative and implement feed() instead of feedAllAnimals().
issues.suggestedFix: Make the identifier consistent. Either (A) update the template example in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java to call farm.feedAllAnimals() instead of farm.feed(), or (B) add a public void feed() wrapper in the Farm class that delegates to feedAllAnimals() (public void feed() { feedAllAnimals(); }) so the example in Main remains valid while preserving the canonical API name feedAllAnimals() used in the problem statement and solution.
